🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector participation (10/11 sectors) but MAJOR divergence across large caps (NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +0.82% | 1M: -16.22%), CRM RECOVERY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: -12.72%)), Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities leading: CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%), Utilities sector breadth: 9/10 positive. Materials strong: FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%), Materials breadth: 9/11 positive. Consumer Staples showing resilience: MNST ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +6.45%), Consumer Staples breadth: 12/14 positive.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Industrials lagging with short-term weakness: DE CORRECTION (1W: -6.43% | 1M: +19.31%), LMT CORRECTION (1W: -3.73% | 1M: +7.85%), Industrials breadth: 6/15 positive. Technology showing internal rotation and notable divergences: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +0.82% | 1M: -16.22%), Technology breadth: 15/24 positive.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%), NFLX RECOVERY (1W: +9.86% | 1M: -1.16%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%), PYPL RECOVERY (1W: +9.11% | 1M: -17.98%), CRM RECOVERY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: -12.72%). Leadership: Broad (5 sectors). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CRH BELOW TREND (1W: -3.47% | 1M: -2.05%), ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -24.81%), AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.68% | 1M: -3.33%), LMT CORRECTION (1W: -3.73% | 1M: +7.85%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -14.06%). Weakness concentrated in select Tech and Services names; monitor for follow-through.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W movers: CEG (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%), NFLX (1W: +9.86% | 1M: -1.16%), FCX (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%), PYPL (1W: +9.11% | 1M: -17.98%). Note MAJOR divergence: several top 1W names are RECOVERY (1W up / 1M down) — watch for trend breaks rather than assuming durable leadership.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed, internal rotation with short-term bounces and some large-cap weakness; AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.75% | 1M: +5.78%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +0.82% | 1M: -16.22%), GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -8.12%), CRM RECOVERY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: -12.72%). Sector breadth: 15/24 positive.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed but constructive participation; PYPL RECOVERY (1W: +9.11% | 1M: -17.98%) and JPM CORRECTION (1W: -0.62% | 1M: +1.94%) illustrate rotation inside the group while MA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -1.08%) and V BELOW TREND (1W: -0.70% | 1M: -2.43%) lag. Sector breadth: 14/20 positive.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Moderate strength with profit-taking in some leaders; PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.89% | 1M: +2.26%), JNJ CORRECTION (1W: -0.87% | 1M: +9.06%), UNH CORRECTION (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +1.40%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -1.52%). Sector breadth: 12/17 positive.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selectively positioned cyclicals and defensive income names while reducing exposure to high-multiple names showing shallow 1M underperformance; favor FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%), CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%) and MNST ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +6.45%), reduce exposure to ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -24.81%) and ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -14.06%). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; monitor big-cap divergences before adding risk.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) — confirm follow-through; CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%) — momentum. BEARISH: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%), ACN BELOW TREND (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -24.81%) — watch for extension.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities (breadth 9/10 positive) and Materials (breadth 9/11 positive) for continued tailwinds. BEARISH: Industrials (breadth 6/15 positive) — watch for further short-term weakness in DE and LMT.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA BELOW TREND — watch 520 area as short-term support; break would reinforce weakness. AAPL ABOVE TREND — watch 170–175 as support band for continuation. JPM CORRECTION — watch 150 area as breakout/confirm level for resumed financial leadership.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
FCX (+60): Freeport securing extended Grasberg rights — price ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%) — sentiment confirmed. MNST (+55): Q4 beat — price ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +6.45%) — sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (-40): AI-sentiment dampener — price BELOW TREND (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -1.93%) — confirmation of distribution risk. JNJ (-55): talc verdict headlines — JNJ CORRECTION (1W: -0.87% | 1M: +9.06%) — news diverging from longer-term strength, monitor legal risk. CRM (-45): earnings disappointment headlines — CRM RECOVERY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: -12.72%) — negative sentiment vs 1W bounce suggests distribution; watch for follow-through. UNH (-45): exit by large fund — UNH CORRECTION (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +1.40%) — sentiment adds to short-term downside risk. MA (-40): structural interchange concerns — MA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -1.08%) — sentiment confirming softness.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership given broad sector participation but large-cap divergences. FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +8.76%), CEG ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.94% | 1M: +12.05%) and AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.75% | 1M: +5.78%) showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap divergences (NVDA BELOW TREND; MSFT RECOVERY; CRM RECOVERY) and negative sentiment on select names (CRM, NVDA, JNJ) — monitor for trend confirmation before adding core exposure.
